input: Source a reliable international shipping service for gifts

gold.taskTitle: Source a Reliable International Shipping Service for Gifts
gold.taskDescription: Find and select a trustworthy international shipping provider suitable for sending gifts abroad.

questions.title: Which countries are you shipping the gifts to?
questions.description: Identify the specific destination countries to narrow down eligible shipping providers.

questions.title: What is your approximate budget per shipment?
questions.description: Understand the cost constraints to filter services by affordability.

questions.title: How large or heavy are the gifts being shipped?
questions.description: Determine package dimensions and weight to assess carrier suitability and pricing.

questions.title: How quickly do the gifts need to arrive?
questions.description: Establish delivery speed requirements to distinguish between standard and express options.

questions.title: Are the gifts fragile, perishable, or restricted items?
questions.description: Identify any special handling, customs, or compliance requirements for the contents.

questions.title: How many shipments do you plan to send in total?
questions.description: Clarify shipment volume to evaluate whether bulk or business-tier pricing is relevant.

questions.title: Is package tracking a must-have for your shipments?
questions.description: Determine whether real-time tracking capability is a required feature of the chosen service.
